title: After connection to Fortinet VPN succeeds, tooltip still says "Connecting to [VPN]" until plasmashell is restarted
line: The Networks tooltip now switches from "Connecting to" to "Connected to" as soon as a VPN finishes connecting, instead of staying stale until plasmashell restarts.
explanation: The Networks tooltip text decides whether a VPN is connecting or connected from the VPN's own state, but it was only recomputed when the active connection's general state changed. When the VPN state reaches Activated after the last active connection state change (as with Fortinet's two-step login), nothing recomputed the text, so it kept saying "Connecting to" while the icon, which does watch the VPN state, already showed the lock. The change also recomputes the text on VPN state changes, and makes the existing state connection unique so it isn't duplicated each time the active connections change.

commits.message:
libs/networkstatus: update the status text when a VPN state changes

The tooltip text read the VPN state but was only refreshed on active
connection state changes, so a VPN that finished connecting after that
kept saying "Connecting to". Also listen to the VPN state changes.

BUG: 521254

media.caption: Pure master: the VPN has finished connecting (lock icon), but the tooltip still says "VPN: Connecting to FortiVPN"
With the fix: same steps, the tooltip says "VPN: Connected to FortiVPN"
